cat: A cat. Temporal: cats come and go, each one is a distinct individual.
dog: The one dog who lives at the house. Unique, shared, long-lived.
factory: Builds and holds animals. Knows which animals are shared and which are fresh; clients never see it.
provider: The client's only door to animals. Hides all construction and all sharing rules.
singleton: Exactly one instance exists for the life of the program; every handle points to that same instance.
temporal: Short-lived and replaceable; identity is per-instance, never shared.
